regime.label: Dealer long-gamma pocket 1050-1090 as put protection is unwound into the rally
evidence: Net GEX +3,876 total and +4,802 within 30 points of the 1066 anchor: every strike from 1050 to 1090 contributes positive gamma, so dealer hedging around spot dampens rather than chases.
Put OI fell 718 contracts (-6.2%) to 10,908 while call OI held at 11,357, dropping P/C OI to 0.96 - the first sub-1.0 reading in nine sessions (1.076 on 10-23).
ATM IV 10.84% sits at the bottom of its nine-session range (12.17% on 10-21), putting the 1-sigma day at 7.28 points, 0.68% of the 1066 anchor.
Max pain 1050 has not moved in nine sessions while the future rallied from 1043.1 to 1066, leaving spot 16 points above an immovable anchor at 62 DTE.

S50Z26.today_summary: 1066 on the Dec future, 1.2 lower on the day, sitting 16 points above a max pain of 1050 that has not moved in nine sessions. Net GEX is +4,802 within 30 points of spot, so the 1050-1090 band is a dealer long-gamma pocket that absorbs rather than amplifies moves. Put OI fell 718 contracts to 10,908 and P/C OI broke below 1.0 for the first time in the window, while put volume stayed heavy at 773 versus 570 calls - protection being closed, not added. ATM IV at 10.84% is the cheapest in nine sessions, pricing a 1-sigma day of only 7.28 points.
what_changed: P/C OI ratio dropped to 0.96 from 1.076 on 10-23, the first sub-1.0 print in nine sessions, on a 718-contract fall in put OI.
Gamma flip migrated down to 1090 from 1100 yesterday, and from no crossing at all on 10-21 through 10-23 - the long-gamma shelf is moving toward spot.
Net GEX swung from -1,653 on 10-21 to +3,876 today; the local reading within 30 points of spot went from -264 to +4,802.
ATM IV compressed 1.33 vol points from 12.17% on 10-21 to 10.84%, shrinking the 1-sigma day from roughly 8.2 to 7.28 points.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: The decisive five-session change is a dealer gamma sign flip: net GEX ran -1,653 on 10-21, -1,338 on 10-22, -113 on 10-23, then +2,987 on 10-27 and +3,876 today, with the local reading around spot turning from -264 to +4,802. That flip is what the 22.9-point rally from 1043.1 to 1066 was built on - as the future climbed through the 1050-1080 call stack, dealers moved from amplifying to absorbing. Call OI built 1,492 contracts over the window while put OI is now rolling over, so the fuel for the move was call accumulation and the brake is the long-gamma pocket it created. Max pain never budged from 1050 and the 1100 call wall never budged either, so the structure that framed the range nine sessions ago still frames it now, 23 points higher. The caution flag is Vol2Vol: at 1060 put OI fell 305 against only 67 lots traded, so part of today's unwind is position reconciliation rather than observable flow and should not be read as clean liquidation.

strategies.name: Iron condor 1020P / 1000P x 1100C / 1120C
strategies.rationale: Sells outside the 1020 near put wall (941 OI) and the 1100 structural call wall (1,689 OI, unchanged for nine sessions) while +4,802 of local dealer gamma suppresses realized range inside 1050-1090.
strategies.defined_risk: Net credit roughly 4.9 points at quoted bid/ask; max loss = 20-point wing width minus credit, about 15.1 points on whichever side is breached. Negative-skew payoff - size small.
strategies.invalidation: A close beyond 1100 or 1020. The call wing is the exposed one: call OI built 1,492 contracts over five sessions and 1080/1090 saw the heaviest call volume today at 91 and 81 lots.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1030 / 1000
strategies.rationale: Downside convexity is cheapest exactly when the book has just sold it: put OI fell 718 contracts today and ATM IV at 10.84% is a nine-session low, with the 25D put at 1030 marked 11.04%.
strategies.defined_risk: Net debit roughly 4.2 points at quoted bid/ask; max loss is that debit in full, max value 30 points at or below 1000.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1090 - the 25D call strike and the cumulative gamma flip - confirms the upside continuation and retires the hedge thesis.

S50Z26.prediction: Base case is a 1050-1090 range: 1-sigma is 7.28 points a day, the long-gamma pocket absorbs moves inside that band, and max pain at 1050 has anchored nine straight sessions. A close above 1090 flips the cumulative GEX positive from spot upward and opens the 1100 call wall as the next test; a close below 1050 breaks the pocket and re-exposes the short-gamma shelf that runs down to the 1020 near put wall.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no instruction to execute anything. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker than for share-settled single stocks: treat max pain at 1050 as a tendency, not a magnet. At 62 DTE the pin logic is weak in any case, and macro or news flow can override the option structure outright. Vol2Vol caveat: the 960 put wall (1,963 OI) traded only 31 lots and sits 10% below spot - it is structural, not live - and today's put OI decline at 1060 exceeded the volume printed there, so part of it is reconciliation rather than flow.
